LanguageData.RACurseSA.CurseEndedDesc: The vicious curse from the void has dissipated. The colonists are free to act again.
LanguageData.RACurseSA.EatingWithoutTableDesc: Everyone must eat at a table. Violators will be severely punished.
LanguageData.RACurseSA.CursePoisoning: {0} got food poisoning for breaking the curse's taboo.
LanguageData.RACurseSA.ResearchDesc: No one may perform research or scanning work. Violators will be severely punished.
LanguageData.RACurseSA.KillAnimalsDesc: No innocent animal may be killed. Violators will be severely punished.
LanguageData.RACurseSA.CurseChimeraSpawn: A chimera bursts out of the body of the wrongfully killed animal!
LanguageData.RACurseSA.WoundedDesc: No one may suffer any harm. Violators will be severely punished.
LanguageData.RACurseSA.CutTreeDesc: No tree may be cut down. Violators will be severely punished.
LanguageData.RACurseSA.OnlyApplyToColonistsDesc: If enabled, curse punishments only affect colonists. If disabled, they affect everyone involved (including raiders, guests, etc.).
LanguageData.RACurseSA.PermanentCurseDesc: If enabled, curse incidents no longer apply a timed game condition. Once a curse falls, it stays forever until you clear it manually with the button below.
LanguageData.RACurseSA.CursesCleared: All active curses have been cleared.
